items.title: Express Scripts targeted by Arkansas pharmacies in first-of-its-kind lawsuit
items.reason: This reports the first lawsuit filed under a new Arkansas state law targeting a major PBM (Express Scripts) for underpayment practices, representing regulatory enforcement and litigation against a payer/intermediary entity that directly impacts healthcare revenue cycle operations.
items.summary: Twelve independent pharmacies in Arkansas have filed the first lawsuit against Express Scripts under a new state law enacted last year that grants pharmacies authority to sue pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) for underpayments. The lawsuit represents the initial enforcement action under Arkansas's new legislative mechanism designed to address PBM reimbursement practices. This development is significant for revenue-cycle teams because PBM reimbursement rates directly affect pharmacy margins and payment processing, and successful litigation could establish precedent for similar claims in other states or by other provider types challenging payer reimbursement adequacy.
